initial_application: The Jira comment cites git 80086b8f22b9b182c473fbb7b7a446d7aafbd37c, but that commit changes Subscription narrative rather than the designation-use value set. Later issues FHIR-19960 and FHIR-29821 are already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-19960 intentionally adds consumer and preferredForLanguage, explaining the current four-concept value set without conflicting with the definition removal.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source/valueset/valueset-designation-use.xml compose contains fully specified name, synonym, consumer, and preferredForLanguage only, and exact source searches found no designation-use definition code to remove.
